models_evaluated: four retinal AI systems (including an APTOS-based update)

links.outcome: Patient-level detection, flags and net benefit after local model updates versus no update
links.effect: Brier loss improved in all eight cohort-system comparisons; in mBRSET flags rose from 154–442 to 809–951 per 1,000 and missed positives fell from 51–133 to 2–14; net benefit was below no update at p=0.20.
links.quote: At audit budget 200, mean Brier loss improved in all eight cohort–system comparisons.

links.outcome: Whether image-level metrics predict patient-level utility of local updates
links.effect: Image-level Brier improvement did not ensure patient-level benefit; in mBRSET at p=0.20 all four updates lowered mean net benefit, adding 5.7–9.5 flags per additional detection.
links.quote: Image-level improvement did not ensure patient-level benefit.

links.outcome: Updated AI net benefit compared with no update, flag-all and flag-none policies
links.effect: In mBRSET at p=0.05 three of four updates had lower net benefit than flag all; in DeepDRiD at p=0.20 the APTOS update raised net benefit by 0.0510 over no update and exceeded both simple policies.
links.quote: Whether an update outperformed the unchanged, flag-all and flag-none policies depended on the cohort and threshold probability.

links.effect: Brier loss improved in all 8 cohort–system comparisons, but mBRSET p=0.20: all 4 updates lowered mean patient-level net benefit.
links.quote: Local updates improved image-level Brier loss in all eight cohort–system comparisons, but in mBRSET at p=0.20 all four lowered mean patient-level net benefit, adding 5.7–9.5 positive flags per additional detection.

links.effect: In mBRSET p=0.20, all 4 updates exceeded flag all but remained below no update.
links.quote: In mBRSET at p=0.05, three of four updates had lower mean net benefit than flag all; at p=0.20, all four exceeded flag all but remained below no update.

links.effect: Brier loss improved in all 8 comparisons; mBRSET net benefit worsened at p=0.20, while DeepDRiD APTOS net benefit improved by 0.0510.
links.quote: Whether an update outperformed the unchanged, flag-all and flag-none policies depended on the cohort and threshold probability.

links.outcome: comparison with unchanged and simple policies
links.effect: mBRSET p=0.05: 3 of 4 updates lower than flag all; DeepDRiD p=0.20: APTOS +0.0510 over no update.
links.quote: In DeepDRiD at p=0.20, the APTOS update increased mean net benefit by 0.0510 over no update and exceeded both simple policies.

unlisted_practices: Using patient-level detection, positive flags, and net benefit rather than image-level metrics alone to evaluate retinal AI updates.

links.outcome: net benefit of updated models compared to no update
links.effect: In mBRSET at p=0.05, three of four updates had lower mean net benefit than flag all, and at p=0.20 all four updates remained below no update.
links.quote: In mBRSET at p=0.05, three of four updates had lower mean net benefit than flag all; at p=0.20, all four exceeded flag all but remained below no update.
